Advances: specled.coverage_capture

Deliverable:
New SpecLedEx.Coverage.Boundary (lib/specled_ex/coverage/boundary.ex): head/1 snapshot at setup, tail/2 snapshot+diff at on_exit (Runner-awaited via exec_on_exit); rows into a boundary ETS table. SpecLedEx.Case (lib/specled_ex/case.ex), an ExUnit.CaseTemplate forwarding opts and injecting the setup line. Store envelope gains additive :meta map (tolerant read for older artifacts). mix spec.cover.test --per-test creates the public anonymous ETS table and arms boundary_table: tid through the seam keyword form (merged over production defaults — no seam redesign). Formatter transitional change ONLY: flush/1 prefers a boundary row when present for a test key (hooked tests' records derive exclusively from their window); unhooked tests keep today's lazy rows. Spec amendments to .spec/specs/coverage_capture.spec.md per refined plan Stage 1 (new requirements boundary_hook_sync, boundary_noop_unarmed, case_template, boundary_row_exclusive, per_test_exclusive_attribution, envelope_meta + scenarios + verification stubs; append-only-safe additions; flip stubs to execute:true as tests land). docs/coverage.md gains a short "Wiring the per-test boundary hook" subsection (claims stay observed/approximate — the wording upgrade is S2's).
Hot-path constraint (retro specled_-47j): tail path is two snapshot reads + one diff + one ETS insert; no module_info calls; no raw snapshot retained outside the on_exit closure.
Full detail: refined plan Stage 1 — /Users/mz/vaults/rmbrs-vault/plans/src-specled_ex/2026-07-24-per-test-sync-boundary/runs/20260724-072714-claude-mini/05-refined-plan.md

- Tests to pass: test/specled_ex/coverage/boundary_test.exs (window diff semantics, unarmed no-op, diagnostics pass-through — stub snapshot_fn via seam); test/specled_ex/case_test.exs incl. named test "SpecLedEx.Case is a no-op under plain mix test"; test/mix/tasks/spec_cover_test_test.exs seeded exclusivity integration (child-BEAM two-test fixture hooked via SpecLedEx.Case, disjoint functions, three distinct explicit seeds, records disjoint and confined to own function lines — deterministic, never statistical); existing cumulative_parity tripwire keeps passing with hook active.
- Behaviors to demonstrate: scenarios for boundary_hook_sync, boundary_noop_unarmed, case_template, boundary_row_exclusive, per_test_exclusive_attribution, envelope_meta (authored in this stage's spec amendment).
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: compile-graph-scoped checks only (mix test --stale or named files) plus mix spec.check --no-run-commands; no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, full merge-gate list run-until-green: mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused && mix spec.check (bare).
  - Verifier tier: flipped stubs and targeted/--stale selections only; no full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test exercising that production path
  - No flaky tests: exclusivity assertions must be deterministic (explicit seeds), never statistical
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface

- Call-site Integration: Mix.Tasks.Spec.Cover.Test.run_per_test/2 (creates + arms the boundary table) and SpecLedEx.Coverage.Formatter.flush/1 (consumes boundary rows) are the production callers; proven by the seeded exclusivity integration test.
